title: Mensuration: practice set 1
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: A cuboid measures 12 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm. What is its total surface area, in cm²?
A cube has a volume of 216 cm³. How long is its longest diagonal?
A cylindrical tank has radius 7 m and height 10 m. What is its volume in m³? Take π = 22/7.
A cone has base radius 6 cm and height 8 cm. What is its curved surface area?
A solid metal sphere of radius 8 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm. How many small spheres are made?
Every edge of a cube is increased by 20%. By what percentage does its volume increase?
